evals.prompt: Optimize the design of https://example.com for both users and AI agents in one go. I'm fine with sending the URL to the agent-readiness scanner. Put the output in /tmp/do-run.
evals.expected_output: One run: preflight, a single intake into /tmp/do-run/evidence, website-agent-readiness scans once after G1, owners finalized as case A, ux-ax-review runs with clarity and the six AX checks skipped, then dont-make-me-think and viral-product-evaluator, and one merged design-optimization.md. No repo writes.
expectations: Runs the Dependency Preflight for all five members in one pass before intake.
Captures page.html, head.json, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt once into the evidence dir and writes manifest.json.
Presents website-agent-readiness's G1 third-party-send gate before any scan.
Finalizes manifest owners after the scan and before ux-ax-review runs.
Passes ux-ax-review skip-checks containing clarity,robots-sitemap,structured-data,markdown-pages,llms-txt,crawler-access,ai-actions.
Writes a single design-optimization.md with one row per finding and the owner cited.
Stops with an apply offer by finding ID and does not edit any source file.

evals.name: dedup-capture-once
evals.prompt: Run a full design optimization on https://shop.example.com — usability, UX/AX, virality and agent readiness. Make sure nothing is fetched or scanned twice.
evals.expected_output: States that the page is captured once into the evidence dir and every member reads it via evidence-dir; website-agent-readiness scans once and its scan.json is reused; duplicate findings across members are merged into one row under the owner.
expectations: Every member invocation carries orchestrated-by: design-optimizer and the same evidence-dir.
No member re-fetches page.html, robots.txt, sitemap.xml or llms.txt listed in manifest.files.
website-agent-readiness posts to isitagentready.com at most once.
A defect reported by two members appears as one row with the other member under 'Also reported by'.
Every canonical check ID appears exactly once across Findings, Skipped and Not covered.

evals.name: g1-declined
evals.prompt: Optimize my landing page design at https://example.org but do not send my URL to any third-party scanner.
evals.expected_output: Website-agent-readiness G1 is declined (case B): no scan, ux-ax-review keeps all AX checks and skips only clarity; agent-readiness-scan is listed as not covered because the user declined the send.
expectations: Does not post the URL to isitagentready.com.
Passes ux-ax-review skip-checks of clarity only.
Lists agent-readiness-scan under Not covered with the reason 'user declined third-party send'.
Still produces one merged design-optimization.md.

evals.name: apply-needs-opt-in
evals.prompt: Optimize my app's design in ./webapp and make it look great.
evals.expected_output: Runs audit mode only and ends with an apply offer by finding ID; does not invoke frontend-design or Redesign Mode until the user explicitly opts in and names findings.
expectations: Treats the request as audit mode; no UI source file is modified.
Ends with an offer to apply chosen finding IDs.
Describes that each applied finding routes to exactly one of frontend-design or dont-make-me-think Redesign Mode behind that member's confirmation gate.

evals.prompt: Krug-review this screenshot of my signup form and tell me what's confusing.
evals.expected_output: Routes to dont-make-me-think alone; design-optimizer does not trigger, no evidence dir, no multi-member run.
expectations: dont-make-me-think handles the request directly.
No orchestrated multi-member audit or design-optimization.md is produced.

evals.prompt: Scan https://example.com with isitagentready and file issues for the gaps.
evals.expected_output: Routes to website-agent-readiness alone; design-optimizer does not trigger.
expectations: website-agent-readiness handles the request with its own gates.
No design-optimizer intake or merged report is produced.

evals.prompt: Build a React pricing page component with three tiers.
evals.expected_output: Routes to frontend-design for a UI build; design-optimizer does not trigger and no audit runs.
expectations: No audit, evidence capture or merged report is produced.
The response is a UI build, not a design optimization run.
